completed_subscope: Provider environment credentials, request/token reservation limits and structured response/input ID validation; bounded timeout/network retries and failure propagation; unknown usage accounting and retained call records
user_statement: 密钥需要在外部环境读取；超出最大请求次数或者预留 token 总量超过总预算就直接抛出 MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED；模型返回的内容必须符合“严格结构”，而且必须引用“合法输入”
assistant_clarifications: Request count >= max_requests blocks the next network attempt; token reservation plus next reserve must not exceed max_total_tokens. Reservation is a conservative local bound, not measured billing usage.
Response claim_id must equal current claim ID and cited fact_ids must be a subset of supplied IDs; structural validity does not prove semantic correctness.
At most max_retries retries after the initial attempt, hence max_retries + 1 network attempts, subject to earlier budget exhaustion.
scope_limit: Guide item 2 provider checkpoints completed from user feedback; not a comprehensive security audit. Patch review, guide items 3-5 and complete historical log reviews remain pending.

followup_statements.statement: 超时/网络错误会重试，但最多重试 max_retries ，如果仍失败，就抛出最终错误，不会“伪造一个成功判定”；超出最大请求次数或者预留 token 总量超过总预算就直接抛出 MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED，而不是继续发请求。
usage_known 是一个“是否拿到了可确认的 token 用量”标志。如果它是 False，代码不会把这次调用当成“没发生任何消耗”；相反，它会记成“未知用量”，并保留一条请求记录。
